description: Mätningar Bredbandskollen mobilt och fast is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Region Blekinge. Geographic grid (250m x 250m) with results of measurements, fixed and mobile, through the Internet Foundation's application Bredbandskollen. Coverage: Region Blekinge. The portal shows the English title as "Measurements Bredbandskollen mobile and fixed" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Region Blekinge. Its keywords include Bredband, Bredbandskollen, Internetstiftelsen. The listing shows 6 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
